title: Ek Chammach Taara = 100 Crore Ton!
idea: A teaspoon of neutron star matter would weigh about a billion tons on Earth. The star holds more mass than the Sun in a ball about 20 km wide, and the fastest one spins 716 times per second.

lines.text: Ek taara aisa hai jiska ek chammach 100 crore ton ka hai!
Iska naam Neutron Star — Sooraj se bhaari, par sirf 20 km chauda!
Uska sirf ek chammach maal — wajan poore 100 crore ton!
Ghar ka pankha minute mein 350 chakkar lagata hai, ye 43,000!
Yaani ek second mein 716 chakkar, satah pe roshni ki 24% speed!
Ek chammach 100 crore ton ka! Kaunsa fact zyada pagal hai — wajan ya speed?

facts.claim: On Earth, one teaspoon of neutron star matter would weigh about a billion tons (100 crore ton). Some estimates go as high as 3–4 billion tons.
A neutron star is about 20 km across, roughly the size of a city, and holds 1.4 to 2 times the Sun's mass.
The Sun's diameter is about 1.39 million km.
The fastest-spinning known pulsar, PSR J1748-2446ad, spins at 716 Hz (about 42,981 RPM), and its equator moves at about 24% of the speed of light.
McGill University's team discovered the 716-rotations-per-second pulsar.
A typical 1200 mm Indian ceiling fan runs at about 350 RPM, per the listed spec of the Usha Swift 1200 mm.
